data.name: Aroush
data.gender_notes: Aroush is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'arus', meaning 'exalted, noble'. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies high moral character and spiritual enlightenment. The name Aroush carries the meaning “Noble, exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aroush usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle touch of God's mercy and compassion.
data.etymology: Aroush belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aroush total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
